headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for the Fellow Stagg EKG Pro (Wi-Fi). See the [README](https://github.com/tomtastic/homebridge-stagg-ekg-pro#readme) for setup instructions.

url.title: Base URL
url.description: Base URL of the kettle (no trailing slash).

minTemp.title: Minimum Temperature (°C)
minTemp.description: Lowest target temperature exposed to HomeKit.

maxTemp.title: Maximum Temperature (°C)
maxTemp.description: Highest target temperature exposed to HomeKit.

pollIntervalHeating.title: Heating Poll Interval (ms)
pollIntervalHeating.description: How often to check kettle state and publish temperature while heating.

pollIntervalIdle.title: Idle Temperature Interval (ms)
pollIntervalIdle.description: How often to check kettle state and publish temperature while idle (not heating).

syncTime.title: Sync Kettle Clock
syncTime.description: Set the kettle clock to the host system's local time when Homebridge starts and once per day.
